caption: Fixed English labels in the weekly plan.
eval: (async()=>{if(!app.plugins.plugins['obsidian-tasks-plugin']?.apiV1){await app.plugins.disablePlugin('obsidian-tasks-plugin');await app.plugins.enablePluginAndSave('obsidian-tasks-plugin');}for(let i=0;i<100&&!app.plugins.plugins['obsidian-tasks-plugin']?.apiV1;i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));if(!app.plugins.plugins['obsidian-tasks-plugin']?.apiV1)throw new Error('Tasks 8.5.0 did not load');const p=app.plugins.plugins['task-field-labels'];p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.enabled=true; p.settings.selectedPreset=''; p.settings.folderRules=''; p.settings.compact=false; await p.saveSettings();const leaf=app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf(); const s=leaf.getViewState(); await leaf.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'source',source:false}});await leaf.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'preview'}});for(let i=0;i<100;i++){if(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .task-due')).some(e=>e.getClientRects().length&&e.textContent?.includes(':')))break;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}if(!Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .task-due')).some(e=>e.getClientRects().length&&e.textContent?.includes(':')))throw new Error('Visible field labels did not render');return 'ok';})()
